originalFamilyScopeSummary: Fix pay with token UI issues in lite mode including error handling and button visibility
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete: fix(perps): Fix UI and error handling for 'pay with token' in lite mode
notes: The PR keeps unknown pay-token balances as undefined, shows at most one funding message, and blocks Place Order until the live balance resolves. This run rebased onto origin/main and re-applied the missing skipBalanceError debounce filter so a Perps-balance error does not linger after switching to a wallet token.
